facts.fact: Decree 54 of September 2022 makes spreading falsehoods by electronic means an offence; an amendment replacing jail with fines of 10,000 to 20,000 dinars for first offences took effect on 2026-09-30, per Al Jazeera.
The journalists' union SNJT recorded six prosecutions of journalists under Decree 54 between April 2025 and April 2026.

TUN.note: Document states nothing the study asks for this country.

facts.fact: Lawyer and columnist Sonia Dahmani was sentenced to two years in May 2026 for criticising prison conditions in a radio interview, charged under Decree 54, per Al Jazeera.
The journalists' union SNJT and civil society groups demanded Decree 54 be scrapped altogether, per Al Jazeera.
